Openness Perspectives Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(8) AI Amplifies Openness

  • Coding Agents [Coding Agents (1)] are used at design time (writing code)
  • Business Agents [Business Agents (1)] are used at runtime (replacing code)
  • Both can be combined (agents creating agentic systems)


Openness Perspectives Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(9) Coding Agents

  • Reading and adapting code has become cheaper
  • Open Source allows to tweak products
  • Open Interfaces allow to integrate products
  • The combo (source+interfaces) creates compounding value


Openness Perspectives Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(10) Business Agents

  • The future a mix of deterministic and probabilistic code
  • Open Interfaces help to architect flexible systems
  • Open Weights help to adapt probabilistic code
  • The combo (interfaces+weights) creates compounding value

Openness & AI Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(12) AI Gateways

  • Manage shadow AI and make consumption visible and manageable
  • Add filters and controls as necessary
  • Necessary component for using and scaling AI responsibly


Openness & AI Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(13) Open Models

  • Reduce token cost by running open models locally
  • Improve sovereignty by keeping data under your control
  • Better model utilization by mixing and tweaking models


Openness & AI Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(14) Composability & AI

  • As little AI as possible and as much AI as necessary
  • Use clean and stable interfaces to expose and consume capabilities

(16) Adopting AI Speed

  • A renewed focus on open interfaces and open data
  • An increasing focus on smaller and tweakable models
  • A new way of modularization (deterministic/probabilistic)
  • Analyzing and tweaking code becomes more achievable


Conclusions Erik Wilde: Openness Matters: Source and Interfaces in the Age of Agents

(17) Monday Tasks

  • Make AI consumption part of your API governance
  • Make SLMs and local models part of your strategy
